evidence.note: FERC scoping notice, docket CP26-572-000: new Hutchinson Compressor Station on Hugoton Loop Line RA plus 1.6 mile 30-inch Line RE to the Evergy meter station at the McNew plant, Reno, Harvey and Stafford counties

Length 1.6 mi pipe plus compression.
